name: Teen Volunteers, Plainsboro Township Recreation and Community Services
org: Plainsboro Township Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at big township events like Founders Day, Haunted Tonight and International Celebration. You can also run kids programs, clean trails and pack food pantry bags. Or be a Shadow Buddy for children with special needs.
deadline_text: Volunteers are used as needed. No dates are posted for applying.

name: BOLD Summer Camp (BioCONECT Oncology Leadership Development), Rutgers Cancer Institute
org: Rutgers Cancer Institute and Rutgers School of Public Health

org: Rutgers University-New Brunswick, Office of Summer and Winter Sessions

name: SLAAM Engineering Summer Academy, Rutgers Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
org: Rutgers School of Engineering, Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
what_you_do: Do a research project every morning. In the afternoon, work on group design projects. Rutgers engineering faculty and grad student mentors guide you. Bring a Windows laptop.

what_you_do: You can take up to two approved college-level courses at Rutgers-New Brunswick. You earn college credit. You take them during the summer.
deadline_text: 2026: applications opened February 2; last day to apply May 17 (Session I) and June 28 (Session II). 2027 dates not posted.

grades: Entering 10th, 11th or 12th grade in fall 2026, with at least one high school biology course

org: Rutgers Environmental and Occupational Health Sciences Institute (EOHSI)
what_you_do: This is a one-week summer camp in the daytime. It is on the Rutgers Busch campus. It focuses on basic lab techniques and toxicology topics.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: enrollment opened January 5, 2026; deadline was Monday, March 2, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Free college prep all year. You get SAT/ACT prep, tutoring, college tours and STEM workshops. A six-week Summer Institute on campus is required. It has college-level classes.
deadline_text: The page says online applications open in mid-September and close in mid-December each year. It has a heading for the Upward Bound Math-Science 2027 Application but no direct application link.

name: Rutgers Young Scholars Program in Discrete Mathematics
what_you_do: This is a four-week residential summer program on the Busch campus. It is for math-talented high school students. You solve discrete math problems.
deadline_text: 2026: reviewed first come, first served from February 2026; completed application, including solutions to the problems, by March 31 if seeking a scholarship; financial aid applications by April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Teen / High School Volunteers, Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital
org: RWJBarnabas Health, Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital
what_you_do: You greet, direct and escort visitors. You visit patients on nursing floors. You help with patient discharges. This is at the hospital's New Brunswick or Somerset campus.

name: Waksman Institute Summer Experience (WISE)
org: Waksman Institute of Microbiology, Rutgers University
what_you_do: This is two weeks of lab work and bioinformatics. The work is on duckweed DNA at the Waksman Institute. Students' vetted sequences are published on GenBank with their names.

name: Student Volunteering, Woodbridge Public Library
what_you_do: Pick a library volunteer job. You can write book reviews online for hours, or help get program materials ready at the Community Service Club. You can read with kids as a Reading Buddy, or help at the summer reading club.

what_you_do: Help the township review its youth programs, suggest new ones, promote events and do service at township events. The board has one formal meeting each fall. The rest of the work is by email or phone.

what_you_do: Join a 4-H club, after-school program or camp and learn by doing. Topics are science, arts, healthy living, outdoors, leadership and citizenship.

org: Rutgers School of Engineering / State of New Jersey

grades: Not stated on the page. See the Application and Admission FAQ.

org: City of Philadelphia Office of Children and Families, with JEVS Human Services

deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. FAQ: summer applications open between March and April each year.

org: Civil Air Patrol, Northeast Philadelphia Composite Squadron (PA-214)

what_you_do: Join one of three Saturday morning workshops: Robotics, Science in the City, or Science Investigators. They have career talks, mentoring and field trips. High school Franklin Ambassadors join each workshop to help the students.
deadline_text: The page has an Apply link but no dates for the current year.

what_you_do: Learn about the Delaware River, caring for nature, STEM and local history. Then share what you learn with visitors on the museum floor. Ambassadors also build speaking and teamwork skills.

what_you_do: Help at a hospital just north of Philadelphia. You might help staff on patient floors, show people where to go, or sit with patients. You do not need any medical training.
deadline_text: Rolling. No deadline posted.

org: Jefferson Health Northeast (Torresdale, Frankford and Bucks County hospitals)

deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates and no year. The 2024 packet said applications are accepted from February until April.

deadline_text: The page says applications for the Summer 2027 program will open in October 2026. The deadline is not posted yet.

what_you_do: Take part in an art program that meets twice a week at a high school site, in school or after school. The page says students can go on to apply for scholarships, internships and jobs in the creative field.
deadline_text: Rolling admission is open (page). The fall session begins in late September 2026.

deadline_text: The page still says registration closed for the C2L-PHL Summer 2025 program. No 2026 or 2027 dates posted.

deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 season were due Aug 1, 2026 and are closed. Next season is not posted.

name: Roots Rising Youth Crews
what_you_do: Teens work on farm crews and at the Pittsfield Farmers Market, with workshops. Fall and spring crews include transportation.
deadline_text: No dates posted. There are three crew seasons a year.

name: Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: High schoolers build leadership skills. They meet twice a month, on the first and third Tuesdays at 7 pm. They give 10 volunteer hours over the school year.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 deadline was Sept 4 at 5 pm. The page says applications for 2027-28 open in July 2027.

name: Teen Summer Volunteer (TSV)
what_you_do: Teens give at least 10 hours in one role. The roles are Literacy Advocate (online), Maker Assistant (Mondays and Wednesdays, 2 to 4 pm) and Program Intern. Teens also finish Teen Summer Reading.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 open April 15, 2027. In the usual cycle they close June 5 at 5 pm and decisions come June 15.

name: Peer-to-Peer Service Collective for Teens
what_you_do: Pitch your own workshop or activity for other teens and families. If chosen, library staff help you shape it, promote it and present it at a library branch. Builds planning and public speaking skills.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 submissions are open Sept 21 to Oct 31, 2026. The spring window is Feb 1 to Feb 28, 2027. Online info session Oct 13, 2026, 5-6 pm.

name: Queens Public Library Teen Volunteering (ages 14-17)
what_you_do: You can volunteer on library projects in Queens. Roles can be ongoing or one-day events. Hours earn community service credit. You can ask for a Service Verification Letter.
deadline_text: Minors can apply year-round. Approval and placement can take up to 30 days, longer in summer and fall.

name: Red Rock Job Corps Center
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes human services and collision repair. It includes carpentry and electrical. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

name: Student Volunteer Program (Medical Pathfinder)
org: Rochester General Hospital, Rochester Regional Health
what_you_do: Students volunteer at the hospital for at least one 3 to 4 hour shift a week. They must come every week unless they are sick or have school plans.
deadline_text: Program dates and deadlines are not listed on the page.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: RochesterWorks with the City of Rochester Summer of Opportunity Program
what_you_do: Youth get six weeks of paid work at job sites across Monroe County. The jobs are matched to their interests.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed April 17, 2026. The page says 2027 applications open starting February 2027.

name: ZooTeens
what_you_do: Teen volunteers work shifts at the zoo over six weeks in summer, mostly at educational stations talking with guests. Teens also complete training.
deadline_text: The page says applications are closed for 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: LEAF Youth Summer Employment
what_you_do: Teens grow and pick vegetables for local restaurants and food banks. They learn cooking skills and join leadership workshops. Work days are split between farm or kitchen work and workshops.
deadline_text: 2026 season: applications closed April 7, interviews April 11, decisions in May. Dates for 2027 not posted.

name: Teen Volunteers for Summer Reading
what_you_do: Teens help at library branches with the summer reading program.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed June 13. The announcement was posted April 23, 2026. 2027 not posted.

name: YouthGROW
what_you_do: Teens work on city organic farms in Worcester. They learn to lead, job skills, city farming and fairness. The program has a 6-week summer boost, fall and spring sessions and monthly workshops.
deadline_text: REC runs an annual spring hiring process for new youth. No exact teen dates are posted.

name: Junior Docent Program
what_you_do: Teens take part in a four-year junior docent program at the Hudson River Museum. After two full years and a staff review, students can qualify to be paid.
deadline_text: 2026-27 portal is open. Deadline October 30, 2026 at 8 pm. New recruit meetings begin in December 2026.
